thread:
Ana (eng-release): starting tenant-archive-ttl migration in the 2h change window. plan: schema add 'archived_at' nullable, run backfill to set value, then switch TTL consumer.
deploy-bot: kickoff tenant-archive-ttl v1 -> v2: preflight checks passed. steps: preflight, schema, canary-backfill, rollout-backfill, finalize.
Diego (db): quick note: the schema add is non-blocking but backfill will touch hot partitions. recommend canary on 2 light shards first.
Kai (sre): monitoring ready: latency, lock_wait, temp_buffers. alert: lock_wait > 800ms for 90s -> :rotating_light:.
Ana (eng-release): canary shards 02 & 05. Diego, be ready to abort.
deploy-bot: preflight complete. applying schema: `ALTER TABLE tenant_events ADD COLUMN archived_at timestamptz NULL;`
Diego (db): schema applied on primaries. replicas caught up.
deploy-bot: starting canary-backfill shard-02 batch=50 worker=1
Kai (sre): shard-02 backfill started. small spike in db temp usage but under threshold.
oncall-bot: reminder: rollback hook set -> `/ops rollback tenant-archive-ttl --scope canary`
Ana (eng-release): canary running 7m, no regressions. proceed shard-05 canary.
deploy-bot: canary shard-05 started.
Tess (product): FYI we should mention in release notes that archived rows are immutable post-migration.
Kai (sre): alert: shard-05 lock_wait 1.1s sustained for 2m. triggering hold.
Ana (eng-release): pausing rollout. Diego, status?
Diego (db): looks like a vacuum overlap and a long-running analytics query on shard-05. I can pause analytics and retry canary with batch=20.
Ana (eng-release): good. apply pause to analytics, reduce batch and retry canary. if lock_wait > 1s for 3m auto rollback.
deploy-bot: canary retried shard-05 batch=20 worker=1 -> running
Kai (sre): lock_wait peaked 650ms then normalized. safe to continue after 10m stable.
Ana (eng-release): resuming rollout with conservative defaults: batch=40, stagger=90s, worker=2.
deploy-bot: rolling out backfill across remaining shards with adjustments.
Diego (db): on shard-13 we saw temp_buffers climb; lowered worker to 1 for that shard.
deploy-bot: adjusted worker_count shard-13 -> 1
Kai (sre): one retryable conflict on shard-19, resolved by automatic retry. no impact.
deploy-bot: finalize step: updating TTL consumer to honor archived_at.
Tess (product): review release blurb: "Tenant archive migration v2: added archived_at, staged backfill with canaries, no customer-visible downtime. One shard required reduced batch due to concurrent maintenance; rollback safeguards prevented wider impact."
Ana (eng-release): posting release notes and closing change window. retrospect ticket to follow for vacuum cadence.
deploy-bot: migration complete. change_window closed. release_id: rc-2026-03-21-archive-ttl-01
Kai (sre): filing follow-up: bump vacuum schedule on heavy shards and add analytics-query window restrictions during backfills.
Diego (db): creating tasks for fine-grained backfill rate limits.
Ana (eng-release): thanks all — great coordination.
